versions.changelog: Add LICENSE + complete SKILL.md frontmatter fields (author/triggers/version)
Declare required env IDFM_PRIM_API_KEY + add base-url exfiltration warning
Fix publish bundle; improve journeys output formatting

- Initial release of idfm-journey-skill for Île-de-France Mobilités (IDFM) journey planning and incident checks.
- Supports place resolution, journey planning, and retrieving disruptions/incidents via the PRIM/Navitia API.
- Provides command-line scripts for querying places, planning journeys, and checking incidents.
- Requires setting the `IDFM_PRIM_API_KEY` environment variable before use.
